message.content: Microsoft Corporation, a technology sector company with two members in its group, closed at 493.95 during a session where the price ranged between 490.15 and 495.19 with volume of 18.88 million shares. The stock is currently in an uptrend supported by immediate support edges ranging from 491.30 to 500.60 and facing resistance at 506.35, while the 20-day average stands at 494.46 and the 50-day average is 450.95. The business state is improving with an operating margin of 45.1 per cent compared to 44.9 per cent a year earlier, supported by seven consecutive quarters on the same side as the prior year. Sales growth remains robust at 18.1 per cent for the same quarter a year before and 17.7 per cent on a year earlier, with the latest earnings reaction showing an actual of 4.74 against an estimate of 4.21.
